title: The Lord of the Rings (BBC Radio)
identity_notes: BBC Radio 4 adaptation of Tolkien’s novel. Frozen GRH set is the thirteen-part hour-long edit derived from the original 26 half-hour 1981 serial, not the original 26-part broadcast sequence.

eras.label: Original 26-part BBC Radio 4 serial
eras.notes: Original stereo serial in twenty-six half-hour episodes.

eras.label: BBC 13-part hour edit
eras.notes: Re-edited into thirteen hour-long broadcasts with restored/rearranged material and linking narration/music changes.

historical_context.title: Earlier BBC Lord of the Rings adaptation
historical_context.description: BBC previously broadcast a twelve-part adaptation; no recordings are known to survive.

historical_context.title: Original 26-part BBC Radio 4 serial
historical_context.description: The major stereo adaptation first aired in twenty-six half-hour Sunday episodes with Wednesday repeats.

historical_context.title: Thirteen-part hour-long re-edit
historical_context.description: The 1981 production was re-edited into thirteen hour-long episodes, restoring/rearranging some material and adding linking narration/music changes.

historical_context.title: 2002 BBC reissue and rerun
historical_context.description: BBC reissued and reran the production around the film-era revival, with later release edits/framing kept separate from the 1982 broadcast identity.
